visuals.caption: Rays from B swing from the chord BA down toward the tangent BD, each making a new angle with BA.
Tangent line through A with a 100° angle between the tangent and chord AC; chords AD, AC and CD drawn.
Two tangents from A touch the circle at C and B, with a 125° angle at D.
Chords CB and BA, a 120° arc on top, a 70° angle at B and the tangent through A.
Triangle ABC in a circle, tangent at B, and a segment XY parallel to the tangent.
Triangle ABC in a circle with ray AD at A; angle ACB and angle DAB carry matching arcs.
Triangle ABC with AC and CB marked equal, angle B of 65° and a 130° angle between ray AD and AB.
Triangle ABC with a 75° angle between ray AD and AB, 60° at A, and 5x° and 3x° at C and B.
Triangle ABC with a ray AD from A, a 60° angle between AD and AB, AC = 3 cm and BC = 6 cm.
Triangle ABC inscribed in a circle, tangent line through A with D on it, and chord XY inside parallel to BC.
Chord BA and the tangent BC meet at B on the circle.
Three circles with a tangent at B: one with a 230° arc, one with diameter AB, one with an equilateral triangle.
Triangle DAB inscribed in a circle, with the tangent BC at B.
The same triangle DAB with radii MA and MB drawn from the centre M.
Tangent BC with a 70° angle at D, an arc marked y° and the tangent-chord angle x° at B.
Diameter AD with chords to B and E, a 30° angle at A, y° at E and x° at B against the tangent.
Centre M with radii MA and MB, a 25° angle at A, y° at D and x° at B against the tangent.
Tangent BC with chords AB, BE and AE forming angles ABC and AEB.
